nodes.body:
Follow-up fixes (from review feedback):
- Stable-id keying: make gateway-scoped state consistently use an effective stable id (`stableID || url.absoluteString`) so client-id overrides persist.
- GatewayDiagnostics log: add size cap + truncation (best-effort, checked every N writes) to avoid unbounded growth.

Tests:
- `pnpm ios:build`
- `xcodebuild test` (apps/ios)

Landed on `main` via squash commits:

- 730f86dd5 Gateway/Plugins: device pairing + phone control plugins (#11755) (stack base)
- 6aedc54bd iOS: alpha node app + setup-code onboarding (#11756)

Local gate:

- pnpm build
- pnpm check
- pnpm test

Closing this PR since the changes are now on `main`.
